mapper.select: select f.id, f.user_id as userId, f.product_id as productId, p.name, p.description, p.price, p.stock, p.category_name as categoryName, p.image, p.status, p.sales from t_favorite f left join t_product p on f.product_id = p.id where f.user_id = #{userId} order by f.id desc
select id, user_id as userId, product_id as productId from t_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId} limit 1
mapper.delete: delete from t_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId}
